family_A.description: additional literal keys for full OFB, CTR, Panama, Arcfour

family_B.description: historical 8-bit OFB recurrence over actual ECB primitives

model.assignment_bound: exact maximum-weight bijection over the 16x16 high-nibble matrix, computed only when row-max is weak
model.pair_bound: ordered-pair-class relaxation after weak assignment bound
model.full_ascii_solver: exact only for 100 percent ASCII; never used to claim 75 percent exclusion

family_B_recurrence.source_semantics: ECB-encrypt register; emit byte zero; shift left one byte; append emitted byte

limits: No Rev7 bytes are read or evaluated.
Panama and Arcfour fixed-keystream status remains empirical because their underlying C sources are absent from the captured package.
A bound at or above 75 percent is unresolved unless a sound stronger weighted bound decides it. Full-ASCII CSP UNSAT alone does not exclude 75-percent ASCII.
